hbs.title: State-wise Expenditure on Relief on Natural Calamities

meta.coverage: State-wise Expenditure on Relief on Natural Calamities: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 105
meta.note: DBIE report 1650, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor); DBIE's unit column says: LAKH. Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: actual, revised estimate, budget estimate. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split). Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
